listing.name: Project Gotham Racing — pgr1-recomp (hk21x)
listing.summary: Native title runtime and modern frontend described; the extent of working races and career progression has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European title 4D530003 PALv5 game with XBE SHA1 4878c3bdbd44663b64ce64986b313e8c6b7f8917. Other releases are not accepted.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run PGR1Launcher.exe with your own disc as described in the README. It downloads a portable toolchain and compiles locally. Review and accept the tool licences through the supported setup process.

warnings: Native title runtime and modern frontend described; the extent of working races and career progression has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
